bundle.shortDescription: Songstress — album-grid music player for Fedora
bundle.longDescription:
Songstress is an album-grid-centric local music player for
Fedora (Wayland, Plasma and GNOME). It scans your music folders, builds a library in
SQLite, and plays everything through MPV (gapless, ReplayGain, 10-band
equalizer, shuffle/repeat, play-next queue) with full MPRIS and Plasma
Global Menu integration.
